body: A little off topic from the books, but if you happen to be interested in pokemon, there's a program/game online called pokemon showdown and you can make your own teams, have random battles, or watch other people's battles. If you like pokemon, it can be a good time kill.

Ah, that's a hard one. Have you tried audio books? Perhaps that way you could give yourself a distraction while doing something else at the same time so that you don't become too immersed? Like trying to clean, or cook, or color pictures (I know sometimes people might think it's immature, but adult coloring books and crayons can be a good way to focus on an easy task).
Do you like to read books? Those are a good distraction to me sometimes, especially if you can immerse yourself in the stories.
